people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

people.name: Korah
people.line: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: The Levites, of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites, stood up to praise Yahweh, the God of Israel, with an exceedingly loud voice.
translations.bsb: And the Levites from the Kohathites and Korahites stood up to praise the LORD, the God of Israel, shouting in a very loud voice.
translations.kjv: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.
translations.asv: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites, stood up to praise Jehovah, the God of Israel, with an exceeding loud voice.
